description: This file defines the 'Attribute' controller class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles CRUD operations, listing, form rendering, and autocompletion for product attributes within the admin catalog section.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Controller class managing attribute CRUD and listing operations in the admin panel for the catalog section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the attributes list page, setting up necessary data and view rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Simple method to load the attribute list via controller.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the list of attribute groups with pagination, sorting, and filtering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the attribute creation/edit form, loading existing data if present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of attribute group data, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected attribute groups after permission and dependency checks.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides JSON data for attribute name autocompletion feature.
